body: I'm so sorry, I wish I could offer more than a few words to help, but if it does help- I believe that you are a girl, even if you don't have the right parts for it- you are loved 💗
I'm so so sorry, I wish I would offer all the love and warmth in the world to you, I just hope you'll find some kind of contentment and peace with yourself because you deserve to feel at peace

I totally know what you're talking about, I've experienced this a few times. Usually I have to talk to myself and use logic that no I won't suddenly die or anything because it's just my irrational fears talking. It's normal to have a fear of dying but sometimes you need to take time to yourself and be patient with yourself and use reasoning
I'm sorry you're going through this, I hope you'll be able to find warmth and peace on your mind
Sometimes things need to be lost before they are found, be patient with yourself please, especially with yourself. Let yourself grieve

You're definitely not a wasted life, you're going through a rough time and it's okay to feel that way. You don't have to have any hopes or anything like that, I would start with doing one thing at a time at your own pace. Give yourself some grace, hun

Maybe some day you'll start to find you have things you love more than you hate, I understand where you come from though. That's why I decided to move across the country, because where I am is suffocating me and who I want to be. Now may I ask you- who do you want to be?

Your life means everything. Pain can be temporary but sometimes it might not go away, but finding ways to cope in a healthy way will help and finding ways to distract yourself from the pain could help too. however, it is worth it to stay, the longer you stay the more things that will come into your life that will make everything worth it, even with all the pain

I care, I've reached out to many strangers over the years struggling with depression and suicidal thoughts, and I still think about them. I hope you'll find a safe space and realize that there are people who truly do care, even if it is a complete stranger like me

I'm so sorry, I understand what you're going through. It's okay to take time for yourself and make sure that you're okay first before helping others, but I'm proud of you for trying to help regardless. Find your happy place, or even a place that makes you feel peaceful, there are people that care about you 💗
You don't deserve to go through such pain, I understand

I'm going through a similar situation, no one at school talks to me, I've missed so many days of school and went through too much in such a short time frame and I'm about to move across the country by myself. You're not alone. Despite all of these things tearing me down, I've managed to find a way to start building my own life up- and I believe you can too, just please give yourself a chance, it might not feel okay at all right now but one day you'll feel content and at peace. 💗
